candidates.source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (GZK) — official gazette / consolidated legislation portal
candidates.why_relevant: Single authoritative index of every act published in Kosovo, including laws on banks, the Central Bank, payment services and AML. Confirmed by fetch to expose advanced search, act-type and institution filters, laws-in-force list, consolidated-acts view and per-year gazette archives, in five languages (sq, sr, en, tr, bs). This is the version-history backbone for A3: it lets you establish what a rule said before amendment and when each amendment entered into force.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of LawInForceList.aspx, consolidatedacts.aspx and GazetaZyrtareYear.aspx; diff ActID pages over time to detect amendments; ASP.NET postback pagination means a session-aware scraper (or headless browser) is needed rather than plain GET pagination.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) + direct fetch of portal root

Confirmed by fetch: trilingual (sq/en/sr), filters by institution, open/closed status and date range, with per-consultation pages carrying the comment deadline. This is the primary A3 deadline feed for draft financial-sector acts (e.g. Draft Law on Payment Services).

candidates.source_name: CBK / BQK — Legal framework: instructions and procedures (Udhëzimet dhe Procedurat, Korniza Ligjore)
candidates.why_relevant: The supervisor's own rulebook index. Rule PDFs sit under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/ with a ?lang= switch giving sq / sr / en variants — meaning CBK is itself the de-facto English-translation source for Kosovo financial legislation. Superseded rule PDFs are commonly removed or silently replaced at the same path, which is exactly why archive snapshots matter for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian for a CBK/BQK public-consultation page for draft regulations ('projektrregullore', 'konsultim publik', 'afati i komenteve') and for CBK entries on the central konsultimet.rks-gov.net platform.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CBK-run consultation register and no CBK consultation on the central platform surfaced. Results returned only finalised CBK regulation PDFs, plus consultation notices from unrelated bodies (Prosecutorial Council, Judicial Council). The central platform's institution filter is oriented to ministries and the PM Office; the CBK is an independent institution and appears not to consult through it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If CBK secondary rules (rregullore) are not consulted on any indexed platform, deadline intelligence for the supervisor's own rulebook cannot come from a consultation feed — it must come from diffing the CBK rulebook index and from Wayback snapshots. That materially changes the collection design for A3.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language search for a commercial consolidated-law database covering Kosovo acts ('propisi', 'baza propisa', 'zakon o platnim uslugama').

negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no commercial fallback if GZK consolidation lags. Kosovo version history is single-sourced on gzk.rks-gov.net plus web archives, which raises the value of our own snapshotting and makes GZK a single point of failure worth monitoring for availability.

coverage_gaps.description: No English-language *consolidated* version of Kosovo financial legislation was found — only English translations of laws as originally gazetted (e.g. Law 04/L-093 as of 2012), while the Albanian text has since been superseded by Law 08/L-304 on Banks (2026).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat English CBK PDFs as point-in-time translations, never as current law; build a mapping table English-PDF -> gazette issue -> superseding act, and flag any English text whose Albanian counterpart has been amended.

coverage_gaps.description: Two of the cell's three core hosts need non-trivial access: bqk-kos.org 403s plain fetches, and konsultimet.rks-gov.net does not server-render its result rows. gzk.rks-gov.net is ASP.NET postback-paginated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for a headless-browser collector for all three, with per-host UA/rate policy, rather than assuming a requests-and-parse pipeline.

coverage_gaps.description: No independent civil-society legislation/consultation monitor for the financial sector was identified in this cell (one governance NGO, GLPS, appeared incidentally monitoring an unrelated programme).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe Kosovo think tanks (GLPS, GAP Institute, Riinvest, KDI) for consultation-quality monitoring and legislative trackers — these often preserve withdrawn drafts that official sites delete.

brief: Kosovo's pointer/archive layer for banking-and-payments rulemaking rests on three official hosts: gzk.rks-gov.net (the Official Gazette, with laws-in-force and consolidated-acts views in sq/sr/en/tr/bs) for published text and version history, konsultimet.rks-gov.net (the central Public Consultation Platform mandated by Regulation 05/2016, trilingual, filterable by institution and open/closed status) for draft acts and comment deadlines, and kuvendikosoves.org for parliamentary stage tracking — with the Government's Programme of Draft Laws 2025-2027 and the PKIE EU-alignment programme supplying the forward calendar before anything is consulted. The critical structural finding is that the CBK does not appear to consult through the central platform and publishes its rulebook as PDFs under bqk-kos.org that are replaced in place, so supervisor-level version history must be reconstructed by checksum-diffing those PDFs and by Wayback snapshots (coverage of the host is confirmed, depth unmeasured). English texts exist and are published by the CBK itself via a ?lang=en query-string convention, but they are point-in-time translations of originally gazetted laws, not consolidations — Law 04/L-093 on Banks circulates in English while the Albanian framework has moved on to Law 08/L-304 (2026), a trap worth encoding explicitly. Access is the main engineering risk: bqk-kos.org returns 403 to plain fetches (bot-defended, presumed live) and the consultation list does not server-render its rows, so all three core hosts need a browser-grade collector.
